name: Improved Eagle Eye
description: Eagle Eye always works: before every battle the hero fires a free Magic Arrow at every enemy stack (10 x Spell Power + 10 / 20 / 30 damage), and has a 100% chance to learn every spell the enemy cast in a battle your hero wins, up to level 2 / 4 / 5 (Basic / Advanced / Expert). Wisdom still limits the spell level.
author: An Bui
